description: Coverage waivers for pre-v0.2-retained UI-heavy files. Each waiver links a follow-up issue and 180-day expiry. No v0.2-added paths are waived.

waivers.reason: Mostly create_login_form/create_register_form/create_forgot_password_form/create_reset_password_form factories — large FastHTML form templates (id/cls/hx_post sprawl) with low ROI to unit-test; each function composes many FormRow/FormHint/RequiredMark components. The 4-line _login_error_message and 18-line create_message_alert have limited branch coverage value.
